method: Cohort movement compares a card's latest move to the median move of everything else the same illustrator drew that we can price. Fewer than three priced cards is not a cohort and produces no verdict.

coverage.note: Catalogue counts are complete for the sets ingested; an 'ever' claim is valid only for artists whose sets are all present.

attributions.read: Card A moved up 8%, and the rest of Test Artist's priced work moved up 8.5% with it. When a whole body of work reprices together it usually reflects something about the illustrator rather than this one card.

Card D moved up 40% while the rest of Test Artist's priced work sat at +8.5%. A card moving alone usually means something about that card — the Pokémon, the set, or its place as a chase — rather than the artist.
